per_version_requirements: ZIP contains exactly one root ro-crate-metadata.json
ZIP has no duplicate, absolute or parent-traversal member path and passes CRC verification
raw archive SHA-256 and byte count are recorded as transport receipts
normalized content identity is SHA-256 over sorted non-directory member records containing path, uncompressed bytes, content SHA-256 and normalized Unix file type/executable-bit class

content_identity_rule.scientific_content_identity: normalized RO-Crate member-manifest SHA-256, not raw ZIP SHA-256
content_identity_rule.why: raw ZIP serialization can change because of member order, timestamps, compression or packaging while the member bytes remain identical; raw archive hashes remain transport receipts only

pair_requirements: both frozen versions satisfy per-version requirements
before and after normalized RO-Crate content-manifest SHA-256 differ
workflow family occurs once in the frozen source snapshot
